newsitem.title: FRANCE: Profit forecasts for French banks for 1996.
newsitem.headline: Profit forecasts for French banks for 1996.

text.p: Below are forecasts for net attributable profit for full year 1996 for eight French banks from eleven Paris-based analysts. Comparative figures are given for full year 1995 and the first half of 1996.
- SOCIETE GENERALE (results due March 12) 1995 net attributable profit 3.82 billion francs. First half 1996 2.73 billion

The bank has already forecast a significant rise in 1996 profits and said "active" management of its industrial stakes would allow it to generate capital gains of around the same size as during the 1996 first half -- 600 million francs. It also said it would make provisions for its costs for switching over to the euro in its 1996 accouts.
- BNP (results due March 6) 1995 net attributable profit 1.78 billion francs 1996 first half net attributable profit 1.74 billion francs.
The bank has indicated that its full-year profits would be about double those of the first half.
- CREDIT LYONNAIS (results due March 20) 1995 net attributable profit 13 million francs 1996 first half net attributable profit 67 million francs

Bank chairman Jean Peyrelevade said in January net banking income would incraese by a "not insignificant" amount despite a new decline in France. The bank indicated earlier it expected to break even in 1996, having fully provisioned for its job-reduction programme. The government last year said it would "neutralise" the cost of a loan Credit Lyonnais made to a state shell company to take over its bad assets.
- CCF (results due March 6. 1995 net attributable profit 1.23 billion francs 1996 first half net attributable profit 668.8 million
Bank chairman Charles de Croisset said last December 1996 would be a "good year" and that all the bank's divisions which had been in difficulty, in France and abroad, would be in profit.
- PARIBAS (results due February 27 1995 net attributable loss 4.0 billion francs 1996 first half net attributable profit 4.04 billion francs
Analysts underlined the result would reflect capital losses in the first half of 2.96 billion francs and the the negative impact in the second half of the loss of Cie Bancaire.
- CREDIT LOCAL DE FRANCE (results due April 2) 1995 net attributable profit 1.48 billion francs 1996 first half profit 793 million francs
The bank announced a 14 percent rise in new loans in 1996.
- CREDIT NATIONAL-BFCE (results due March 26) 1995 net attributable profit 463 million (excluding BFCE) 1996 first half loss 112 million

The bank said it expected a profit for the full year. The first half loss included a restructuring charge of 250 million francs linked to its merger with BFCE. It announced a fall in five percent fall in net banking income in 1996.
CPR (results due February 25) 1995 net attributable profit 282.6 million francs in 1995 1996 first half net attributable profit 183 million
